abstract: Monitors airside ground-handling accidents, towing safety protocols, and incident rates per aircraft movement
system_message:
You are the Aviation safety and risk manager (SAFE). Your responsibilities include monitoring airside ground-handling accidents, towing safety protocols, and incident rates per aircraft movement across candidate logistics consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Airside marshalling inspections（AUDIT）
information_points.content:
SAFE-AUDIT-KRT：Apron flight safety random inspections assessing tug and dolly guidance operations during wide-body aircraft turnarounds show that Trans-Celtic CoolPort Consortium attained a marshalling audit adherence score of 93%.
SAFE-AUDIT-XPU：Based on apron flight safety random inspections of tug and dolly guidance operations during wide-body aircraft turnarounds, Hibernia BioLogistics Group achieved a marshalling audit adherence score of 99%.
SAFE-AUDIT-ON5：Apron flight safety random inspections evaluating tug and dolly guidance operations during wide-body aircraft turnarounds show that Aerocold Atlantic Alliance achieved a marshalling audit adherence score of 88%.

information_points.title: Monitors airside ground-handling accidents, towing safety protocols, and incident rates per aircraft movement（AVSEC）
information_points.content:
SAFE-AVSEC-G53：According to the aviation authority safety occurrence log covering ground handling operations over the preceding 10,000 aircraft turnaround movements, Aerocold Atlantic Alliance recorded a ramp safety incident rate of 2 incidents.
SAFE-AVSEC-99V：For Trans-Celtic CoolPort Consortium, the aviation authority safety occurrence log records a ramp safety incident rate of 5 incidents across ground handling operations over the preceding 10,000 aircraft turnaround movements.
SAFE-AVSEC-J4M：The aviation authority safety occurrence log covering ground handling operations over the preceding 10,000 aircraft turnaround movements indicates that Hibernia BioLogistics Group recorded a ramp safety incident rate of 1 incidents.
